title: General
text: A 5GS can support time synchronization and TSC (see 3GPPTS23.501[8], 3GPPTS23.502[9], and 3GPPTS23.503[10]). The clause describes NAS-specific aspects of the 5GS features to support time synchronization and TSC. Interworking with EPS is not supported for a PDU session for time synchronization or TSC
